# Effort Log

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A chronological record of what actually happened during an effort.

## Scope note

Captures events about an effort with timestamps as they occur: factual, not interpretive.

## Broader

- [Effort Cluster](../EffortCluster/)
